description: Mailchimp connected-site loader attribution on chimpstatic.com/mcjs-connected/js/users/{user}/{site}.js. The Connected Sites API returns a site_script URL but does not publish a complete HTTP contract for this route. list-manage.com forms are not contracted.

params.name: user_id
params.description: It is the user path token on this observed connected-site loader family. The cited API defines a returned script URL, not a fixed hash grammar.
params.fix_hint: Copy the connected-site snippet from Mailchimp Integrations so the path is /js/users/{user}/{site}.js.

params.name: site_id
params.description: It is the site path token on this observed connected-site loader family. The cited API defines a returned script URL, not a fixed hash grammar.
params.fix_hint: Keep both path segments from the generated Mailchimp snippet.
